name: omniverse-bridge
description: OmniMemo agent cards, context usage reporting and opt-in fresh-context rollover for Claude Code.

rollover.title: Context rollover
rollover.description: suggest tells you when context is high and /om-rollover hands off; auto replaces the conversation with the verified OmniMemo capsule at the threshold; off reports usage only.

rolloverAt.title: Rollover at (percent)
rolloverAt.description: Reported context usage that triggers the handoff (spec default 80).

prepareAt.title: Prepare checkpoint at (percent)
prepareAt.description: Reported context usage that saves a checkpoint ahead of the handoff (spec default 70).

omPath.title: om command
omPath.description: OmniMemo CLI the mod runs (no shell).
